summary: Iter 321 — verified GET /api/inventory/rolls honors ?limit/?skip/?q in bare-array mode, paged mode envelope still works, outbound scan query works. Frontend Daftar Roll shows default 100/page, first/last/prev/next work, page size 20/50/100 switch, search resets to page 1, CSV export dialog opens. Mobile 390x844 shows persona mobile shell (no direct access to Rolls list — pre-existing app-shell behavior).

issues: Admin at mobile viewport is routed to persona mobile shell (Persetujuan/Notifikasi/Antrean/Ringkas/Produk/Tanya); wms-tab-stok / inventory-tab-rolls not reachable. Not a regression of this iteration, but the task requested mobile verification of the rolls pager — the pager itself was not exercisable at mobile viewport. If mobile access to the Rolls list is expected, main agent should surface a way to reach it from the mobile shell or make the desktop layout available.

action_items: Optional: expose the Daftar Roll screen (or a compact variant) in the mobile persona shell so warehouse users at 390x844 can browse/scan rolls without switching to desktop mode.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/inventory.py list_rolls: limit is correctly clamped to max 5000 and _with_search combines roll_no/lot/batch text with product name/SKU resolution via product_id map — good. Default limit=5000 for the legacy bare-array mode still returns up to 5000 rows (~6MB with 45k rolls); for scanner/select UIs consider lowering the default (e.g., 200) or requiring an explicit limit to further reduce payload.
list_rolls builds products map for the whole tenant on every call (db.products.find({}) with no limit); with 268 SKUs this is fine but note the pattern for future growth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter321_rolls_pagination.py covers bare-array limit/skip/q, paged envelope, and outbound scan style. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_iter321_rolls_pagination.py -n 0. Login endpoint /api/auth/login returns {token,user}; use Authorization: Bearer <token> and X-Entity-Id: ent_ksc.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verification only. Observed measured behavior: GET /api/inventory/rolls default returns 5000 rows for bare-array (was previously ignoring ?limit); with ?limit=100 returns exactly 100; ?skip=5 returns disjoint rows from ?skip=0; ?q=<sku> filters to that product only. Paged mode returns envelope with items/total/has_more. Frontend info text confirms 'Menampilkan 1–100 dari 22985 roll' and pager first/last/prev/next/size-20/50/100 all work; search resets to page 1.
